description: This source file defines the MathInternalError class, which is a custom exception indicating an internal error in the Apache Commons Math library. It extends MathIllegalStateException and provides constructors for different use cases such as generic internal errors, causes, and localized messages.

classes.name: MathInternalError
classes.description: A runtime exception indicating an internal error condition in the Apache Commons Math library, used to signal unexpected, non-recoverable internal errors.

methods.name: MathInternalError()
methods.description: Default constructor that records a generic internal error message with a reporting URL.

methods.name: MathInternalError(final Throwable cause)
methods.description: Constructor that wraps another Throwable cause, indicating the root cause of the internal error.

methods.name: MathInternalError(Localizable pattern, Object ... args)
methods.description: Constructor that accepts a localized message pattern and arguments for detailed error explanation.
